obligation: FCC CPNI rules: Telecom Carrier
basis: The 9 ILECs provide local exchange and toll service as common carriers, and the operating companies provide interconnected VoIP, which 64.2003(o) brings into the rules. No size threshold. 64.2010(h) applies only to CMRS providers (no wireless service). 64.2010(g) business customer terms cover 2,300 enterprise accounts

obligation: FCC CPNI rules: Network Engineering Services, Tower and Fiber Infrastructure, corporate
applies: No (not carriers); the Carrier's limits on sharing with affiliates apply
basis: None of them provides telecommunications service. They are affiliates (47 U.S.C. 153(1); 64.2003(c)) that receive Carrier CPNI only within the limits that bind the Carrier. Group policy POL-04 applies the CPNI standard to the whole customer account record

obligation: FCC outage reporting (NORS, DIRS, 911 special facilities): Telecom Carrier
basis: Wireline communications provider and interconnected VoIP provider; thresholds are outage-based, not size-based

obligation: FCC outage reporting: Network Engineering Services, Tower and Fiber Infrastructure, corporate
basis: None provides wireline, wireless, cable, satellite or interconnected VoIP service. Engineering's 30-minute outage notices to carrier customers are a contract duty (CTR-MNO)

obligation: CALEA system security and integrity: Telecom Carrier
basis: Telecommunications carrier under CALEA (47 U.S.C. 1001(8)(A)); each operating company needs an SSI policy and senior officer

obligation: CALEA system security and integrity: Network Engineering Services, Tower and Fiber Infrastructure, corporate
basis: Not telecommunications carriers

obligation: FCC submarine cable landing license rules: all divisions and group
basis: No division owns or operates a submarine cable, cable landing station or SLTE

obligation: CIRCIA (pending rule): all divisions and group
basis: No final rule published as of 2026-10-05; tracked for planning

obligation: SEC cybersecurity disclosure (also N53-R05): group
basis: The holding company is an SEC registrant; divisions contribute incident facts through the group. Item 1.05(d) allows the CPNI delay for a Carrier breach

obligation: Secure Networks Act covered equipment report: Telecom Carrier
basis: The Carrier provides advanced communications service (broadband) and has certified that it has no covered communications equipment

obligation: FCC EAS cybersecurity order: Telecom Carrier
basis: No video or broadcast service

obligation: FAR 52.204-25 and 52.204-23 (covered telecommunications equipment; Kaspersky covered articles): Network Engineering Services and Telecom Carrier

obligation: FAR basic safeguarding (52.204-21): Network Engineering Services

applies: Where a federal transport contract includes the clause (not analyzed in this sample)
basis: Covered by group common controls; the regulation-by-division matrix records it as not analyzed here

basis: Engineering is not a financial institution under 16 CFR 314.2: it offers no tax preparation, lending, appraisal or settlement services. The regulation-by-division matrix records the same result for the Carrier and corporate

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: Tower and Fiber Infrastructure
basis: Tower and dark fiber leases are real property and private-carriage leases, not the financial activities 314.2 lists

obligation: IRC 7216 preparer disclosure rules: Network Engineering Services
basis: Engineering prepares no tax returns and holds no tax return information

obligation: IRS Publication 4557 (WISP): Network Engineering Services
basis: Applies to tax professionals; Engineering offers no tax preparation services

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 and CMMC: Network Engineering Services

obligation: HIPAA (as business associate): Network Engineering Services
basis: Engineering's MNO, design and federal work handles network data, subscriber data in tickets and FCI; no PHI

citation: ABA Model Rules; Rules Regulating The Florida Bar
basis: Engineering provides engineering and network operations services, not legal services

basis: Engineering is not a CPA firm and provides no attest or accounting services

obligation: CIRCIA (proposed): Network Engineering Services
basis: Same as C-COMMUNICATIONS-R05

basis: No division has operations, customers, sites or landowners in California

basis: Assessed by the Group Chief Privacy Officer outside this security sample
